summary: Implemented a deterministic offline/paper execution ledger for crypto numeric paper order plans. The ledger reads the existing expected paper order plan, applies fixture execution prices, emits submitted and filled paper events, creates a settled paper position with PnL, and preserves no-action entries with reasons.
limitations: Fixture-only ledger; no live markets, prices, APIs, or external metadata are fetched.
Paper fills, settlement, and PnL are deterministic local calculations only.
No runtime integration, dispatcher/run_codex, prompt automation, credentials, wallet access, real orders, live trading, unrelated cleanup, or new validation layer was added.
recommended_next_task: PMBOT-BRAIN-011: add an offline paper lifecycle summary that rolls paper execution ledger positions into portfolio-level status and exposure.
